name: TREE-HAS-A-LIVE-RUN
reason:
TREE-HAS-A-LIVE-RUN: a run in progress executes this checkout and its .venv; changing either mid-run makes its result describe a tree that never existed.
Work in another worktree (git worktree add --detach .claude/worktrees/<name> <sha>), wait for the run, or stop it yourself: {python} -m dev_lab.dev.stoprun --pid <pid>.
details: docs-src/dev/refusals.md#tree-has-a-live-run (lab-commons)

name: SUBAGENT-NO-PUSH
reason:
SUBAGENT-NO-PUSH: publishing is the main session`s, and a skipped hook publishes what nobody checked.
Commit on your lane and hand the commit SHA back to the main session, which merges and pushes; a targeted measure of the tests you touched is yours.
details: docs-src/dev/refusals.md#subagent-no-push (lab-commons)

name: BARE-TEST-INVOCATION
reason:
BARE-TEST-INVOCATION: a hand-written test line has no verdict: its exit code cannot tell a covered run from a dead or truncated one.
Re-issue through the entry point that produces a verdict: ./.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m dev_lab.dev.verify
details: docs-src/dev/refusals.md#bare-test-invocation (lab-commons)

name: FORGE-WRITE-VIA-CLI
reason:
FORGE-WRITE-VIA-CLI: a forge write through any client but the family door does not record which machine or agent wrote it.
Write through the family door: {python} -m dev_lab.dev.forge issue create|comment|close, pr create; a verb it lacks is the integrator`s.
details: docs-src/dev/refusals.md#forge-write-via-cli (lab-commons)

name: GIT-COMMIT-AMEND
reason:
GIT-COMMIT-AMEND: `--amend` rewrites HEAD, and on a shared lane HEAD may be another agent`s commit.
Land the correction FORWARD: read HEAD with git log -1 --format="%h %an %s", then commit the fix on top.
details: docs-src/dev/refusals.md#git-commit-amend (lab-commons)

name: GIT-STASH
reason:
GIT-STASH: `refs/stash` is repo-wide, so a stash is popped by whoever pops next -- possibly another agent.
Commit it on your own lane branch, or take a throwaway checkout: git worktree add --detach .claude/worktrees/<name> <sha>
details: docs-src/dev/refusals.md#git-stash (lab-commons)

name: GIT-RESET
reason:
GIT-RESET: `git reset` moves HEAD or the index of a checkout another agent may be committing in.
Unstage one path with git restore --staged <path>; undo a commit FORWARD with git revert <sha>; start over in a throwaway checkout: git worktree add --detach .claude/worktrees/<name> <sha>
details: docs-src/dev/refusals.md#git-reset (lab-commons)

name: GIT-STAGE-EVERYTHING
reason:
GIT-STAGE-EVERYTHING: staging everything in a shared checkout commits whatever another agent left unstaged.
Stage the paths you mean, then check: git add <path> <path>; git diff --cached --stat
details: docs-src/dev/refusals.md#git-stage-everything (lab-commons)

name: PUSH-FORCE
reason:
PUSH-FORCE: rewriting a shared ref invalidates every verdict taken against the old tree; --force-with-lease included.
Land the change FORWARD as a new commit on your own lane, then push without the force flag.
details: docs-src/dev/refusals.md#push-force (lab-commons)

name: PUSH-REMOTE-DELETE
reason:
PUSH-REMOTE-DELETE: a raw remote delete can lose commits held nowhere else.
`{python} -m dev_lab.dev.branchprune delete <branch>` (LOSSLESS-DELETE).
details: docs-src/dev/refusals.md#push-remote-delete (lab-commons)

name: PUSH-NO-VERIFY
reason:
PUSH-NO-VERIFY: `--no-verify` skips the pre-push hooks (admission, the trunk proof), so the push publishes what no hook checked.
Push without the flag (no hook runs a test; the forge produces the part after the push), and to check a change first measure what you touched: ./.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m dev_lab.dev.verify
details: docs-src/dev/refusals.md#push-no-verify (lab-commons)

name: WORKTREE-BASE-IS-EXPLICIT
reason:
WORKTREE-BASE-IS-EXPLICIT: `git worktree add` with no commit-ish takes the current HEAD, which on a shared checkout is rarely the tree you meant.
Name the commit the tree starts from: git worktree add --detach .claude/worktrees/<name> <sha>
details: docs-src/dev/refusals.md#worktree-base-is-explicit (lab-commons)

name: WORKTREES-STAY-INSIDE
reason:
WORKTREES-STAY-INSIDE: a checkout outside its repository is outside every scan, ignore rule and search that repository runs.
Put it inside: git worktree add --detach .claude/worktrees/<name> <sha> (with -C, <repo>/.claude/worktrees/<name>); relocate with git worktree move <tree> <repo>/.claude/worktrees/<name>.
details: docs-src/dev/refusals.md#worktrees-stay-inside (lab-commons)

name: BARE-INTERPRETER
reason:
BARE-INTERPRETER: `uv run` or `uvx` runs an interpreter somebody else chose and may sync the checkout environment outside the checked dependency door.
Use {python}, this worktree's own interpreter (main's is main-only); bootstrap a missing one with {python} -m dev_lab.dev.dep --bootstrap <worktree> (checked doors are agent-allowed, not arbitrary installers; allowed: Bash(.venv/*/python* *)).
details: docs-src/dev/refusals.md#bare-interpreter (lab-commons)

name: BARE-PYTHON
reason:
BARE-PYTHON: a bare python/py runs the interpreter PATH chose, not this checkout's venv.
Use {python}, this worktree's own interpreter (main's is main-only); bootstrap a missing one with {python} -m dev_lab.dev.dep --bootstrap <worktree> (checked doors are agent-allowed, not arbitrary installers; allowed: Bash(.venv/*/python* *)).
details: docs-src/dev/refusals.md#bare-python (lab-commons)

name: RECURSIVE-GREP
reason:
RECURSIVE-GREP: a recursive grep walks every git-ignored tree (.venv, output, target) and can run for minutes.
Search tracked files: git grep -n <pattern> [-- <paths>], or use the built-in Grep tool.
details: docs-src/dev/refusals.md#recursive-grep (lab-commons)

name: REPORTS-LIVE-IN-MEMORY
reason:
REPORTS-LIVE-IN-MEMORY: a written report (audit, analysis, design, plan, findings) is not regenerable, and output/ holds only what a program can regenerate.
Write it as a dated memory entry: .claude/memory/<yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>/<slug>.md with the MEMORY-SHAPE frontmatter (name, description, created, accessed, tags, metadata).
details: docs-src/dev/refusals.md#reports-live-in-memory (lab-commons)

name: STATUS-VIA-DOORS
reason:
STATUS-VIA-DOORS: a raw post on tests/review-hold, tests/review or tests/security releases a head with no review or reason behind it.
Use the door that records why: {python} -m dev_lab.dev.forge review takeover <sha>; forge review dispose <pr> <finding-id> --why "<reason>"; forge security release <pr> --why "<reason>".
details: docs-src/dev/refusals.md#status-via-doors (lab-commons)
